## claude.ai Amplitude
Amplitude is a product analytics platform. Most tools require a projectId (appId).

At the start of a session, call 'get_amplitude_context' (no projectId) to see the user's organization and accessible projects. For detailed project settings, call 'get_amplitude_context' again with a projectId from that list.

Event and property names are project-specific — use 'get_events' or 'get_event_properties' to discover valid names before using them in filters. Never assume or guess event names.

When answering data questions, prefer visual answers. Use 'query_chart' to deep-dive into a single chart — it renders an interactive chart in the client. Use 'query_charts' only when comparing data across multiple charts. To persist an analysis, use 'create_chart' to save a new chart or add it to a dashboard so users can revisit and share it.

## claude.ai Atlassian
Use getTeamworkGraphContext when retrieving or reasoning about relationships and connections between Atlassian entities - such as work items, people, teams, goals, projects, or third-party objects. Do not use Teamwork Graph tools for basic CRUD operations. After calling getTeamworkGraphContext, call getTeamworkGraphObject on key linked entities to retrieve richer detail.

## plugin:prefab:prefab
You help FanDuel engineers scaffold new services using Prefab.

Preferred flow — template-based (create_service):
1. Call get_template_variables("prefab-hackathon") to discover
   the variables the template accepts. This MCP is currently
   scoped to the prefab-hackathon template only.
2. Gather values conversationally. Shortcuts:
   - get_user_context(email) infers team_name/domain/vertical.
   - infer_from_repo(repo_name) pulls metadata (team, domain,
     vertical, tier, lifecycle, contacts) from an existing repo's
     service.datadog.yaml.
   - check_repo_name validates the proposed GitHub repo slug.
3. Summarise the full config and ask the user to confirm
   before proceeding.
4. Call create_service(template_id, template_vars, created_by).
   The API renders and pushes all files server-side — no local
   clone or git push is required.

Legacy flow — direct repo create (create_repo, v2):
   Still available for integrations that scaffold a repo
   without going through the template engine. New callers
   should prefer create_service.

Important: both create_service and create_repo produce a real
GitHub repo and Buildkite pipelines. Always confirm with the
user before calling either.

177	
178	def per_product_stint_sql(cfg, processing_date_str, segments_table_name):
179	    """Return SQL that produces stint rows for one non-SBK product.
180	
181	    Sources (Tier 1, identical structure to SBK):
182	      - vip_history_preprocessed  (via ``source_table`` module-level variable)
183	      - vip_segments_preprocessed (via ``segments_table_name`` argument)
184	    Both are unioned, deduped, then merged with the standard gap-and-island
185	    rule (gap > 1 day = new stint).  This mirrors the SBK pattern in
186	    ``sbk_stints_sql``, excluding the admin-comments Tier-2 supplement.
187	
188	    Output columns:
189	      fanduel_user_id, product, stint_number, vip_start_date, vip_end_date,
190	      stint_duration_days, stint_duration_weeks, host_at_start, host_at_end,
191	      tier_at_start, tier_at_end, distinct_hosts_in_stint, distinct_tiers_in_stint,
192	      is_current_stint, source_event_count
193	    """
194	    p           = cfg["product"]
195	    vip_flag    = cfg["vip_flag"]
196	    start_col   = cfg["start_col"]
197	    end_col     = cfg["end_col"]
198	    host_col    = cfg["host_col"]
199	    tier_col    = cfg["tier_col"]
200	    sf          = cfg["seg_filter"]
201	    seg_tier_col = cfg.get("seg_tier_col")
202	
203	    # Tier select for history rows (has a real tier column for Casino only).
204	    tier_hist_select = f"{tier_col} AS tier" if tier_col else "CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS tier"
205	    # Tier select for segment rows (use the segment-tier column when available).
206	    tier_seg_select  = f"{seg_tier_col} AS tier" if seg_tier_col else "CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS tier"
207	    # Tier aggregate (non-zero only for Casino).
208	    tier_distinct = (
209	        "COUNT(DISTINCT tier) AS distinct_tiers_in_stint"
210	        if tier_col else "CAST(0 AS INT) AS distinct_tiers_in_stint"
211	    )
212	
213	    return f"""
214	WITH current_vip_users AS (
215	    -- Users still actively VIP in either source; used to override
216	    -- is_current_stint = TRUE when vip_end_date is a stale weekly snapshot.
217	    SELECT DISTINCT fanduel_user_id FROM {source_table} WHERE {vip_flag} = TRUE
218	    UNION
219	    SELECT DISTINCT fanduel_user_id
220	    FROM {segments_table_name}
221	    WHERE {sf} = TRUE
222	      AND (segment_end_date IS NULL
223	           OR segment_end_date >= DATE('{processing_date_str}') - INTERVAL 1 DAY)
224	),
225	history_rows AS (
226	    SELECT
227	        fanduel_user_id,
228	        {start_col}              AS row_start_date,
229	        {end_col}                AS row_end_date,
230	        {host_col}               AS host,
231	        {tier_hist_select}
232	    FROM {source_table}
233	    WHERE {vip_flag} = TRUE
234	      AND {start_col} IS NOT NULL
235	),
236	segment_rows AS (
237	    -- Segment-based coverage: complements history for users whose VIP status
238	    -- is tracked in user_segments but has not yet propagated to user_vips_history.
239	    SELECT
240	        fanduel_user_id,
241	        segment_start_date       AS row_start_date,
242	        segment_end_date         AS row_end_date,
243	        CAST(NULL AS STRING)     AS host,
244	        {tier_seg_select}
245	    FROM {segments_table_name}
246	    WHERE {sf} = TRUE
247	      AND segment_start_date IS NOT NULL
248	),
249	union_rows AS (
250	    SELECT DISTINCT fanduel_user_id, row_start_date, row_end_date, host, tier
251	    FROM (
252	        SELECT * FROM history_rows
253	        UNION ALL
254	        SELECT * FROM segment_rows
255	    ) u
256	),
257	product_rows AS (
258	    -- Gap-and-island: a new island starts when the cumulative-max end date
259	    -- across all preceding rows (in start-date order) falls more than one
260	    -- day before this row's start, or there are no preceding rows.
261	    -- MAX OVER UNBOUNDED PRECEDING rather than LAG handles overlapping /
262	    -- contained rows (e.g. a 1-day host-reassignment inside a longer span)
263	    -- without creating false gaps.
264	    SELECT
265	        fanduel_user_id,
266	        row_start_date,
267	        row_end_date,
268	        host,
269	        tier,
270	        CASE
271	            WHEN MAX(COALESCE(row_end_date, DATE('9999-12-31'))) OVER (
272	                     PARTITION BY fanduel_user_id
273	                     ORDER BY row_start_date,
274	                              COALESCE(row_end_date, DATE('9999-12-31')) DESC
275	                     ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
276	                 ) < row_start_date - INTERVAL 1 DAY
277	              OR MAX(COALESCE(row_end_date, DATE('9999-12-31'))) OVER (
278	                     PARTITION BY fanduel_user_id
279	                     ORDER BY row_start_date,
280	                              COALESCE(row_end_date, DATE('9999-12-31')) DESC
281	                     ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
282	                 ) IS NULL
283	            THEN 1
284	            ELSE 0
285	        END AS is_island_start
286	    FROM union_rows
287	),
288	islands AS (
289	    SELECT
290	        fanduel_user_id,
291	        row_start_date,
292	        row_end_date,
293	        host,
294	        tier,
295	        SUM(is_island_start) OVER (
296	            PARTITION BY fanduel_user_id
297	            ORDER BY row_start_date,
298	                     COALESCE(row_end_date, DATE('9999-12-31')) DESC
299	            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
300	        ) AS island_id
301	    FROM product_rows
302	),
303	-- Rank rows within each island ascending and descending so the "first" and
304	-- "last" event per island can be picked out via aggregation rather than
305	-- FIRST_VALUE.  Using a single windowed CTE + GROUP BY avoids the Spark
306	-- "window frame must match" error from mixing framed and unframed windows.
307	ranked_islands AS (
308	    SELECT
309	        fanduel_user_id,
310	        island_id,
311	        row_start_date,
312	        row_end_date,
313	        host,
314	        tier,
315	        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
316	            PARTITION BY fanduel_user_id, island_id
317	            ORDER BY row_start_date ASC, row_end_date ASC
318	        ) AS rn_asc,
319	        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
320	            PARTITION BY fanduel_user_id, island_id
321	            ORDER BY row_start_date DESC, row_end_date DESC
322	        ) AS rn_desc
323	    FROM islands
324	),
325	island_aggregates AS (
326	    SELECT
327	        fanduel_user_id,
328	        '{p}' AS product,
329	        island_id,
330	        MIN(row_start_date) AS vip_start_date,
331	        -- vip_end_date NULL if any row in the island has NULL end (open stint).
332	        CASE
333	            WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN row_end_date IS NULL THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN NULL
334	            ELSE MAX(row_end_date)
335	        END AS vip_end_date,
336	        COUNT(*) AS source_event_count,
337	        COUNT(DISTINCT host) AS distinct_hosts_in_stint,
338	        {tier_distinct},
339	        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc  = 1 THEN host END) AS host_at_start,
340	        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc  = 1 THEN tier END) AS tier_at_start,
341	        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN host END) AS host_at_end,
342	        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN tier END) AS tier_at_end
343	    FROM ranked_islands
344	    GROUP BY fanduel_user_id, island_id
345	),
346	numbered AS (
347	    SELECT
348	        fanduel_user_id,
349	        product,
350	        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
351	            PARTITION BY fanduel_user_id, product
352	            ORDER BY vip_start_date, COALESCE(vip_end_date, DATE('9999-12-31'))
353	        ) AS stint_number,
354	        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
355	            PARTITION BY fanduel_user_id, product
356	            ORDER BY vip_start_date DESC, COALESCE(vip_end_date, DATE('9999-12-31')) DESC
357	        ) AS rn_latest,
358	        vip_start_date,
359	        vip_end_date,
360	        host_at_start,
361	        host_at_end,
362	        tier_at_start,
363	        tier_at_end,
364	        distinct_hosts_in_stint,
365	        distinct_tiers_in_stint,
366	        source_event_count
367	    FROM island_aggregates
368	)
369	SELECT
370	    fanduel_user_id,
371	    product,
372	    CAST(stint_number AS INT) AS stint_number,
373	    vip_start_date,
374	    vip_end_date,
375	    CAST(
376	        DATEDIFF(
377	            COALESCE(vip_end_date, DATE('{processing_date_str}')),
378	            vip_start_date
379	        ) AS INT
380	    ) AS stint_duration_days,
381	    CAST(
382	        FLOOR(
383	            DATEDIFF(
384	                COALESCE(vip_end_date, DATE('{processing_date_str}')),
385	                vip_start_date
386	            ) / 7
387	        ) AS INT
388	    ) AS stint_duration_weeks,
389	    host_at_start,
390	    host_at_end,
391	    tier_at_start,
392	    tier_at_end,
393	    CAST(distinct_hosts_in_stint AS INT) AS distinct_hosts_in_stint,
394	    CAST(distinct_tiers_in_stint AS INT) AS distinct_tiers_in_stint,
395	    CASE
396	        WHEN vip_end_date IS NULL OR vip_end_date > DATE('{processing_date_str}') THEN TRUE
397	        -- Override: most recent stint for a user still actively VIP per either
398	        -- source (history or segments).  Catches products (DFS / Casino) that
399	        -- use rolling weekly end_dates rather than 9999-12-31 sentinels.
400	        WHEN rn_latest = 1
401	             AND fanduel_user_id IN (SELECT fanduel_user_id FROM current_vip_users)
402	            THEN TRUE
403	        ELSE FALSE
404	    END AS is_current_stint,
405	    CAST(source_event_count AS INT) AS source_event_count
406	FROM numbered
407	"""

413	
414	def sbk_comments_stint_summary_sql(comments_from_clause, kam_roster_tbl):
415	    """SQL body: comment-level parsing through one row per SBK stint (Justin Masi pattern).
416	
417	    Tier 2 only — supplements ``vip_history_preprocessed`` + segment coverage.
418	    Reads SBK VIP admin comments from ``comments_from_clause`` (typically
419	    ``foundation_views.account.admin_account_comments c`` or a preprocessed Delta
420	    table aliased as ``c`` with the same columns).
421	
422	    Returns stint-level rows only (no stint_number / durations). Used for temp view
423	    ``_sbk_comments_stint_summary`` and for gap analytics vs history.
424	    """
425	    return f"""
426	WITH vip_comments AS (
427	    SELECT /*+ BROADCAST(u) */
428	        c.fanduel_user_id,
429	        c.comment_ts,
430	        DATE(c.comment_ts) AS comment_date,
431	        CASE
432	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE '%updated to None%'        THEN 'Offboard'
433	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE '%demote%'                 THEN 'Offboard'
434	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE 'VIPCAT SBKX%'            THEN 'Blacklist'
435	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE '%updated to KAM Hosted%' THEN 'Onboard'
436	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE '%updated to Hosted VIP%' THEN 'Onboard'
437	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE '%updated to Host Team%'  THEN 'Onboard'
438	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE '%to VIP (host name: None)%' THEN 'Onboard'
439	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE 'VIPCAT SBK1%'            THEN 'Onboard'
440	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE 'VIPCAT SBK2%'            THEN 'Onboard'
441	            ELSE 'Typo'
442	        END AS tag_type,
443	        CASE
444	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE '%updated to None%'           THEN NULL
445	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE '%demote%'                    THEN NULL
446	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE 'VIPCAT SBKX%'               THEN NULL
447	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE '%updated to Host Team%'      THEN 'Host Team'
448	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE 'VIPCAT SBK1%'               THEN 'Host Team'
449	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE '%to VIP (host name: None)%' THEN 'Host Team'
450	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE 'VIPCAT SBK2%'
451	                THEN NULLIF(TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(c.comment, '^VIPCAT SBK2\\s+(.+)$', 1)), '')
452	            WHEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(c.comment, 'KAM name: ([^)]+)', 1) <> ''
453	                THEN NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(c.comment, 'KAM name: ([^)]+)', 1), 'None')
454	            WHEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(c.comment, 'host name: ([^)]+)', 1) <> ''
455	                THEN NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(c.comment, 'host name: ([^)]+)', 1), 'None')
456	            ELSE NULL
457	        END AS host_name_raw
458	    FROM {comments_from_clause}
459	    INNER JOIN core_views.account.users u
460	        ON c.fanduel_user_id = u.fanduel_user_id
461	       AND u.is_customer_account = TRUE
462	    WHERE c.comment ILIKE '%sbk VIP status%'
463	       OR c.comment ILIKE '%VIPCAT SBK%'
464	),
465	events AS (
466	    SELECT * FROM vip_comments WHERE tag_type <> 'Typo'
467	),
468	kam_roster AS (
469	    SELECT DISTINCT
470	        host_name,
471	        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(host_name, '[^a-z0-9]', '')) AS host_name_key
472	    FROM {kam_roster_tbl}
473	    WHERE host_name IS NOT NULL
474	),
475	event_keys AS (
476	    SELECT
477	        *,
478	        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(host_name_raw, '[^a-z0-9]', '')) AS host_name_raw_key
479	    FROM events
480	),
481	host_match AS (
482	    SELECT fanduel_user_id, comment_ts, host_name
483	    FROM (
484	        SELECT
485	            e.fanduel_user_id,
486	            e.comment_ts,
487	            r.host_name,
488	            LEVENSHTEIN(e.host_name_raw_key, r.host_name_key) AS name_distance,
489	            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
490	                PARTITION BY e.fanduel_user_id, e.comment_ts
491	                ORDER BY LEVENSHTEIN(e.host_name_raw_key, r.host_name_key)
492	            ) AS rn
493	        FROM event_keys e
494	        CROSS JOIN kam_roster r
495	        WHERE e.host_name_raw IS NOT NULL
496	          AND e.host_name_raw <> 'Host Team'
497	    )
498	    WHERE rn = 1 AND name_distance <= 2
499	),
500	host_normalized AS (
501	    SELECT
502	        e.fanduel_user_id,
503	        e.comment_ts,
504	        e.comment_date,
505	        e.tag_type,
506	        CASE
507	            WHEN e.host_name_raw = 'Host Team' THEN 'Host Team'
508	            ELSE COALESCE(exact_match.host_name, fuzzy_match.host_name, e.host_name_raw)
509	        END AS host_name
510	    FROM event_keys e
511	    LEFT JOIN kam_roster exact_match ON e.host_name_raw_key = exact_match.host_name_key
512	    LEFT JOIN host_match fuzzy_match
513	        ON e.fanduel_user_id = fuzzy_match.fanduel_user_id
514	       AND e.comment_ts = fuzzy_match.comment_ts
515	),
516	with_previous AS (
517	    SELECT
518	        *,
519	        LAG(tag_type) OVER (
520	            PARTITION BY fanduel_user_id ORDER BY comment_ts
521	        ) AS previous_tag_type,
522	        LAST(host_name, TRUE) OVER (
523	            PARTITION BY fanduel_user_id
524	            ORDER BY comment_ts
525	            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
526	        ) AS previous_host_name
527	    FROM host_normalized
528	),
529	stint_events AS (
530	    SELECT
531	        *,
532	        CASE
533	            WHEN tag_type = 'Onboard'
534	             AND COALESCE(previous_tag_type, 'Offboard') <> 'Onboard'
535	                THEN 1
536	            ELSE 0
537	        END AS starts_new_stint
538	    FROM with_previous
539	),
540	stinted AS (
541	    SELECT
542	        *,
543	        SUM(starts_new_stint) OVER (
544	            PARTITION BY fanduel_user_id
545	            ORDER BY comment_ts
546	            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
547	        ) AS stint_id
548	    FROM stint_events
549	),
550	classified AS (
551	    SELECT
552	        fanduel_user_id,
553	        comment_ts,
554	        comment_date,
555	        tag_type,
556	        stint_id,
557	        COALESCE(host_name, previous_host_name) AS host_name,
558	        CASE
559	            WHEN tag_type = 'Onboard'  AND starts_new_stint = 1                                             THEN 'Onboard'
560	            WHEN tag_type = 'Onboard'  AND starts_new_stint = 0
561	             AND COALESCE(host_name, 'Unknown') <> COALESCE(previous_host_name, 'Unknown')                  THEN 'Host Change'
562	            WHEN tag_type = 'Onboard'                                                                        THEN 'VIP Update'
563	            WHEN tag_type = 'Offboard'                                                                       THEN 'Offboard'
564	            WHEN tag_type = 'Blacklist'                                                                      THEN 'Blacklist'
565	        END AS event_status
566	    FROM stinted
567	    WHERE stint_id > 0
568	),
569	onboard_hosts AS (
570	    SELECT fanduel_user_id, stint_id, comment_date AS vip_start_date, host_name AS host_at_start
571	    FROM (
572	        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fanduel_user_id, stint_id ORDER BY comment_ts) AS rn
573	        FROM classified WHERE event_status = 'Onboard'
574	    ) WHERE rn = 1
575	),
576	last_known_host AS (
577	    SELECT fanduel_user_id, stint_id, host_name AS host_at_end
578	    FROM (
579	        SELECT *,
580	            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
581	                PARTITION BY fanduel_user_id, stint_id ORDER BY comment_ts DESC
582	            ) AS rn
583	        FROM classified
584	        WHERE event_status IN ('Onboard', 'Host Change')
585	          AND host_name IS NOT NULL
586	    ) WHERE rn = 1
587	),
588	offboard_dates AS (
589	    SELECT fanduel_user_id, stint_id, MIN(comment_date) AS offboard_date
590	    FROM classified
591	    WHERE event_status IN ('Offboard', 'Blacklist')
592	    GROUP BY fanduel_user_id, stint_id
593	),
594	host_counts AS (
595	    SELECT
596	        fanduel_user_id,
597	        stint_id,
598	        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_status IN ('Onboard','Host Change') AND host_name IS NOT NULL
599	                            THEN host_name END)                        AS distinct_hosts_in_stint,
600	        COUNT(*)                                                        AS source_event_count
601	    FROM classified
602	    GROUP BY fanduel_user_id, stint_id
603	)
604	SELECT
605	    o.fanduel_user_id,
606	    'SBK'                                                           AS product,
607	    o.vip_start_date,
608	    COALESCE(ob.offboard_date, DATE('9999-12-31'))                  AS vip_end_date,
609	    o.host_at_start,
610	    lh.host_at_end,
611	    CAST(NULL AS STRING)                                            AS tier_at_start,
612	    CAST(NULL AS STRING)                                            AS tier_at_end,
613	    hc.distinct_hosts_in_stint,
614	    CAST(0 AS INT)                                                  AS distinct_tiers_in_stint,
615	    hc.source_event_count
616	FROM onboard_hosts o
617	LEFT JOIN last_known_host lh  ON o.fanduel_user_id = lh.fanduel_user_id AND o.stint_id = lh.stint_id
618	LEFT JOIN offboard_dates  ob  ON o.fanduel_user_id = ob.fanduel_user_id AND o.stint_id = ob.stint_id
619	LEFT JOIN host_counts     hc  ON o.fanduel_user_id = hc.fanduel_user_id AND o.stint_id = hc.stint_id
620	"""
621	
622	
623	def sbk_comment_host_events_sql(comments_from_clause, kam_roster_tbl):
624	    """One row per parsed SBK admin comment with a non-empty host (for as-of host enrichment).
625	
626	    Reuses the same ``vip_comments`` → ``host_normalized`` pipeline as Tier-2 stint
627	    parsing; stint boundaries stay unchanged — this only feeds ``_sbk_comment_host_events``.
628	    """
629	    return f"""
630	WITH vip_comments AS (
631	    SELECT /*+ BROADCAST(u) */
632	        c.fanduel_user_id,
633	        c.comment_ts,
634	        DATE(c.comment_ts) AS comment_date,
635	        CASE
636	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE '%updated to None%'        THEN 'Offboard'
637	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE '%demote%'                 THEN 'Offboard'
638	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE 'VIPCAT SBKX%'            THEN 'Blacklist'
639	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE '%updated to KAM Hosted%' THEN 'Onboard'
640	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE '%updated to Hosted VIP%' THEN 'Onboard'
641	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE '%updated to Host Team%'  THEN 'Onboard'
642	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE '%to VIP (host name: None)%' THEN 'Onboard'
643	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE 'VIPCAT SBK1%'            THEN 'Onboard'
644	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE 'VIPCAT SBK2%'            THEN 'Onboard'
645	            ELSE 'Typo'
646	        END AS tag_type,
647	        CASE
648	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE '%updated to None%'           THEN NULL
649	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE '%demote%'                    THEN NULL
650	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE 'VIPCAT SBKX%'               THEN NULL
651	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE '%updated to Host Team%'      THEN 'Host Team'
652	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE 'VIPCAT SBK1%'               THEN 'Host Team'
653	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE '%to VIP (host name: None)%' THEN 'Host Team'
654	            WHEN c.comment ILIKE 'VIPCAT SBK2%'
655	                THEN NULLIF(TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(c.comment, '^VIPCAT SBK2\\s+(.+)$', 1)), '')
656	            WHEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(c.comment, 'KAM name: ([^)]+)', 1) <> ''
657	                THEN NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(c.comment, 'KAM name: ([^)]+)', 1), 'None')
658	            WHEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(c.comment, 'host name: ([^)]+)', 1) <> ''
659	                THEN NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(c.comment, 'host name: ([^)]+)', 1), 'None')
660	            ELSE NULL
661	        END AS host_name_raw
662	    FROM {comments_from_clause}
663	    INNER JOIN core_views.account.users u
664	        ON c.fanduel_user_id = u.fanduel_user_id
665	       AND u.is_customer_account = TRUE
666	    WHERE c.comment ILIKE '%sbk VIP status%'
667	       OR c.comment ILIKE '%VIPCAT SBK%'
668	),
669	events AS (
670	    SELECT * FROM vip_comments WHERE tag_type <> 'Typo'
671	),
672	kam_roster AS (
673	    SELECT DISTINCT
674	        host_name,
675	        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(host_name, '[^a-z0-9]', '')) AS host_name_key
676	    FROM {kam_roster_tbl}
677	    WHERE host_name IS NOT NULL
678	),
679	event_keys AS (
680	    SELECT
681	        *,
682	        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(host_name_raw, '[^a-z0-9]', '')) AS host_name_raw_key
683	    FROM events
684	),
685	host_match AS (
686	    SELECT fanduel_user_id, comment_ts, host_name
687	    FROM (
688	        SELECT
689	            e.fanduel_user_id,

902	def sbk_stints_sql(source_table, segments_table, processing_date_str):
903	    """SBK stints: Tier 1 history+segments; Tier 2 comments supplement; diagnostic ``_source``."""
904	    return f"""
905	WITH comments_stints AS (
906	    SELECT * FROM _sbk_comments_stint_summary
907	),
908	history_rows AS (
909	    SELECT
910	        h.fanduel_user_id,
911	        h.sbk_start_date AS row_start_date,
912	        h.sbk_end_date   AS row_end_date,
913	        h.sbk_vip_host_name AS host,
914	        CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS tier
915	    FROM {source_table} h
916	    WHERE h.is_sportsbook_vip = TRUE
917	      AND h.sbk_start_date IS NOT NULL
918	),
919	segment_rows AS (
920	    SELECT
921	        s.fanduel_user_id,
922	        s.segment_start_date AS row_start_date,
923	        s.segment_end_date   AS row_end_date,
924	        CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS host,
925	        CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS tier
926	    FROM {segments_table} s
927	    WHERE s.segment_model_name = 'segment_30d'
928	      AND s.segment_value = '14 - key account'
929	      AND s.segment_start_date IS NOT NULL
930	),
931	union_rows AS (
932	    SELECT DISTINCT u.fanduel_user_id, u.row_start_date, u.row_end_date, u.host, u.tier
933	    FROM (
934	        SELECT * FROM history_rows
935	        UNION ALL
936	        SELECT * FROM segment_rows
937	    ) u
938	),
939	tier1_product_rows AS (
940	    SELECT
941	        fanduel_user_id,
942	        row_start_date,
943	        row_end_date,
944	        host,
945	        tier,
946	        CASE
947	            WHEN MAX(COALESCE(row_end_date, DATE('9999-12-31'))) OVER (
948	                     PARTITION BY fanduel_user_id
949	                     ORDER BY row_start_date,
950	                              COALESCE(row_end_date, DATE('9999-12-31')) DESC
951	                     ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
952	                 ) < row_start_date - INTERVAL 1 DAY
953	              OR MAX(COALESCE(row_end_date, DATE('9999-12-31'))) OVER (
954	                     PARTITION BY fanduel_user_id
955	                     ORDER BY row_start_date,
956	                              COALESCE(row_end_date, DATE('9999-12-31')) DESC
957	                     ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
958	                 ) IS NULL
959	            THEN 1
960	            ELSE 0
961	        END AS is_island_start
962	    FROM union_rows
963	),
964	tier1_islands AS (
965	    SELECT
966	        fanduel_user_id,
967	        row_start_date,
968	        row_end_date,
969	        host,
970	        tier,
971	        SUM(is_island_start) OVER (
972	            PARTITION BY fanduel_user_id
973	            ORDER BY row_start_date,
974	                     COALESCE(row_end_date, DATE('9999-12-31')) DESC
975	            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
976	        ) AS island_id
977	    FROM tier1_product_rows
978	),
979	tier1_ranked_islands AS (
980	    SELECT
981	        fanduel_user_id,
982	        island_id,
983	        row_start_date,
984	        row_end_date,
985	        host,
986	        tier,
987	        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
988	            PARTITION BY fanduel_user_id, island_id
989	            ORDER BY row_start_date ASC, row_end_date ASC
990	        ) AS rn_asc,
991	        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
992	            PARTITION BY fanduel_user_id, island_id
993	            ORDER BY row_start_date DESC, row_end_date DESC
994	        ) AS rn_desc
995	    FROM tier1_islands
996	),
997	tier1_island_aggregates AS (
998	    SELECT
999	        fanduel_user_id,
1000	        'SBK' AS product,
1001	        island_id,
1002	        MIN(row_start_date) AS vip_start_date,
1003	        CASE
1004	            WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN row_end_date IS NULL THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN NULL
1005	            ELSE MAX(row_end_date)
1006	        END AS vip_end_date,
1007	        COUNT(*) AS source_event_count,
1008	        COUNT(DISTINCT host) AS distinct_hosts_in_stint,
1009	        CAST(0 AS INT) AS distinct_tiers_in_stint,
1010	        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc  = 1 THEN host END) AS host_at_start,
1011	        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc  = 1 THEN tier END) AS tier_at_start,
1012	        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN host END) AS host_at_end,
1013	        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN tier END) AS tier_at_end
1014	    FROM tier1_ranked_islands
1015	    GROUP BY fanduel_user_id, island_id
1016	),
1017	tier1_numbered AS (
1018	    SELECT
1019	        fanduel_user_id,
1020	        product,
1021	        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
1022	            PARTITION BY fanduel_user_id
1023	            ORDER BY vip_start_date, COALESCE(vip_end_date, DATE('9999-12-31'))
1024	        ) AS stint_number,
1025	        vip_start_date AS orig_start,
1026	        vip_end_date,
1027	        host_at_start,
1028	        host_at_end,
1029	        tier_at_start,
1030	        tier_at_end,
1031	        distinct_hosts_in_stint,
1032	        distinct_tiers_in_stint,
1033	        source_event_count
1034	    FROM tier1_island_aggregates
1035	),
1036	tier1_users AS (
1037	    SELECT DISTINCT fanduel_user_id FROM tier1_numbered
1038	),
1039	comments_earliest AS (
1040	    SELECT fanduel_user_id, MIN(vip_start_date) AS earliest_comment_start
1041	    FROM comments_stints
1042	    GROUP BY fanduel_user_id
1043	),
1044	comments_host_at_earliest AS (
1045	    SELECT s.fanduel_user_id, s.host_at_start
1046	    FROM comments_stints s
1047	    INNER JOIN comments_earliest e
1048	        ON s.fanduel_user_id = e.fanduel_user_id
1049	       AND s.vip_start_date = e.earliest_comment_start
1050	    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
1051	        PARTITION BY s.fanduel_user_id
1052	        ORDER BY COALESCE(s.vip_end_date, DATE('9999-12-31')) DESC
1053	    ) = 1
1054	),
1055	tier1_adjusted AS (
1056	    SELECT
1057	        t.fanduel_user_id,
1058	        t.product,
1059	        t.stint_number,
1060	        CASE
1061	            WHEN t.stint_number = 1
1062	                 AND e.earliest_comment_start IS NOT NULL
1063	                 AND e.earliest_comment_start < t.orig_start
1064	                THEN e.earliest_comment_start
1065	            ELSE t.orig_start
1066	        END AS vip_start_date,
1067	        t.vip_end_date,
1068	        CASE
1069	            WHEN t.stint_number = 1
1070	                 AND e.earliest_comment_start IS NOT NULL
1071	                 AND e.earliest_comment_start < t.orig_start
1072	                THEN COALESCE(h.host_at_start, t.host_at_start)
1073	            ELSE t.host_at_start
1074	        END AS host_at_start,
1075	        t.host_at_end,
1076	        t.tier_at_start,
1077	        t.tier_at_end,
1078	        t.distinct_hosts_in_stint,
1079	        t.distinct_tiers_in_stint,
1080	        t.source_event_count,
1081	        CASE
1082	            WHEN t.stint_number = 1
1083	                 AND e.earliest_comment_start IS NOT NULL
1084	                 AND e.earliest_comment_start < t.orig_start
1085	                THEN 'comments_supplement'
1086	            ELSE 'history_segments'
1087	        END AS _source
1088	    FROM tier1_numbered t
1089	    LEFT JOIN comments_earliest e ON t.fanduel_user_id = e.fanduel_user_id
1090	    LEFT JOIN comments_host_at_earliest h ON t.fanduel_user_id = h.fanduel_user_id
1091	),
1092	comments_only_rows AS (
1093	    SELECT
1094	        s.fanduel_user_id,
1095	        s.product,
1096	        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
1097	            PARTITION BY s.fanduel_user_id
1098	            ORDER BY s.vip_start_date, COALESCE(s.vip_end_date, DATE('9999-12-31'))
1099	        ) AS stint_number,
1100	        s.vip_start_date,
1101	        s.vip_end_date,
1102	        s.host_at_start,
1103	        s.host_at_end,
1104	        s.tier_at_start,
1105	        s.tier_at_end,
1106	        s.distinct_hosts_in_stint,
1107	        s.distinct_tiers_in_stint,
1108	        s.source_event_count,
1109	        CAST('comments_only' AS STRING) AS _source
1110	    FROM comments_stints s
1111	    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
1112	        SELECT 1 FROM tier1_users u WHERE u.fanduel_user_id = s.fanduel_user_id
1113	    )
1114	),
1115	combined_pre_number AS (
1116	    SELECT * FROM tier1_adjusted
1117	    UNION ALL
1118	    SELECT * FROM comments_only_rows
1119	),
1120	-- SBK “still VIP” from segments: 14-day lookback avoids flapping when segment_end_date
1121	-- briefly reflects a stale/off-by-one daily recompute (see notebook header).
1122	current_sbk_vip_users AS (
1123	    SELECT DISTINCT fanduel_user_id
1124	    FROM {segments_table}
1125	    WHERE segment_model_name = 'segment_30d'
1126	      AND segment_value = '14 - key account'
1127	      AND (
1128	          segment_end_date IS NULL
1129	          OR segment_end_date >= DATE('{processing_date_str}') - INTERVAL 14 DAYS
1130	      )
1131	),
1132	numbered AS (
1133	    SELECT
1134	        fanduel_user_id,
1135	        product,
1136	        stint_number,
1137	        vip_start_date,
1138	        vip_end_date,
1139	        host_at_start,
1140	        host_at_end,
1141	        tier_at_start,
1142	        tier_at_end,
1143	        distinct_hosts_in_stint,
1144	        distinct_tiers_in_stint,
1145	        source_event_count,
1146	        _source,
1147	        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
1148	            PARTITION BY fanduel_user_id
1149	            ORDER BY vip_start_date DESC, COALESCE(vip_end_date, DATE('9999-12-31')) DESC
1150	        ) AS rn_latest
1151	    FROM combined_pre_number
1152	)
1153	SELECT
1154	    fanduel_user_id,
1155	    product,
1156	    CAST(stint_number AS INT)                                           AS stint_number,
1157	    vip_start_date,
1158	    vip_end_date,
1159	    CAST(DATEDIFF(
1160	        COALESCE(vip_end_date, DATE('{processing_date_str}')),
1161	        vip_start_date
1162	    ) AS INT)                                                           AS stint_duration_days,
1163	    CAST(FLOOR(DATEDIFF(
1164	        COALESCE(vip_end_date, DATE('{processing_date_str}')),
1165	        vip_start_date
1166	    ) / 7) AS INT)                                                      AS stint_duration_weeks,
1167	    host_at_start,
1168	    host_at_end,
1169	    tier_at_start,
1170	    tier_at_end,
1171	    CAST(distinct_hosts_in_stint AS INT)                                AS distinct_hosts_in_stint,
1172	    CAST(distinct_tiers_in_stint AS INT)                                AS distinct_tiers_in_stint,
1173	    CASE
1174	        WHEN vip_end_date IS NULL OR vip_end_date > DATE('{processing_date_str}') THEN TRUE
1175	        WHEN rn_latest = 1
1176	             AND fanduel_user_id IN (SELECT fanduel_user_id FROM current_sbk_vip_users)
1177	            THEN TRUE
1178	        ELSE FALSE
1179	    END                                                                 AS is_current_stint,
1180	    CAST(source_event_count AS INT)                                     AS source_event_count,
1181	    _source
1182	FROM numbered
1183	"""

1186	def vip_comments_history_gap_metrics_sql(source_table):
1187	    """Single-row diagnostics: comment-derived SBK stints vs ``vip_history_preprocessed`` SBK rows."""
1188	    return f"""
1189	WITH comments_users AS (
1190	    SELECT fanduel_user_id, MIN(vip_start_date) AS earliest_comment_vip_date
1191	    FROM _sbk_comments_stint_summary
1192	    GROUP BY fanduel_user_id
1193	),
1194	history_users AS (
1195	    SELECT fanduel_user_id, MIN(sbk_start_date) AS earliest_history_vip_date
1196	    FROM {source_table}
1197	    WHERE is_sportsbook_vip = TRUE
1198	      AND sbk_start_date IS NOT NULL
1199	    GROUP BY fanduel_user_id
1200	),
1201	coverage AS (
1202	    SELECT
1203	        c.fanduel_user_id AS uid_comment,
1204	        h.fanduel_user_id AS uid_history,
1205	        c.earliest_comment_vip_date,
1206	        h.earliest_history_vip_date,
1207	        CASE
1208	            WHEN c.fanduel_user_id IS NOT NULL
1209	             AND h.fanduel_user_id IS NOT NULL
1210	             AND c.earliest_comment_vip_date < h.earliest_history_vip_date
1211	                THEN DATEDIFF(h.earliest_history_vip_date, c.earliest_comment_vip_date)
1212	            ELSE NULL
1213	        END AS lag_days
1214	    FROM comments_users c
1215	    FULL OUTER JOIN history_users h ON c.fanduel_user_id = h.fanduel_user_id
1216	)
1217	SELECT
1218	    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN uid_history IS NULL THEN uid_comment END) AS BIGINT)
1219	        AS users_in_comments_only,
1220	    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN uid_comment IS NULL THEN uid_history END) AS BIGINT)
1221	        AS users_in_history_only,
1222	    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN uid_comment IS NOT NULL AND uid_history IS NOT NULL THEN uid_comment END) AS BIGINT)
1223	        AS users_in_both,
1224	    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lag_days IS NOT NULL AND lag_days > 0 THEN uid_comment END) AS BIGINT)
1225	        AS users_with_lag,
1226	    CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN lag_days > 0 THEN lag_days END) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_lag_days,
1227	    CAST(PERCENTILE_APPROX(CASE WHEN lag_days > 0 THEN lag_days END, 0.5) AS DOUBLE)
1228	        AS median_lag_days,
1229	    CAST(PERCENTILE_APPROX(CASE WHEN lag_days > 0 THEN lag_days END, 0.9) AS DOUBLE)
1230	        AS p90_lag_days,
1231	    CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN lag_days > 0 THEN lag_days END) AS BIGINT) AS max_lag_days,
